correctness.rationale: The selected-edge graph is total dominating iff it has at most one isolate and no isolated K2 component; deleting cycle and leaf edges yields precisely P3 forests or a single isolate with short-legged spider components. The labelled exponential formula for M_n handles the unique four-vertex-path double-center correction; ordinary graph EGF removing singleton and K2 components gives A_n. Independent direct subset enumeration n=3..6 yielded M_3=3z^2,M_4=12z^2,M_5=80z^3,M_6=840z^4, and verified all-set sizes. The combinatorial proof, not finite tests, covers arbitrary n>=3.
residual_risks: No unrestricted proof follows from finite n=3..6 counts alone; actual combinatorial proof was reconstructed.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The prior theorems cover all n and every minimal-set size, strictly broader than a numerical minimum; all-set A_n EGF adds only the textbook EGF exclusion of isolated and K2 components.
